newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline steady, barges set to move higher.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline steady, barges set to move higher.

text.p: NWE gasoline was steady to a shade firmer on Monday, after sellers found good buying interest at Friday's prices and pushed up offers late in the morning.
Premium unleaded barges traded twice at $212 and once at $213 a tonne fob ARA, with a major Rotterdam refiner the buyer.
But sellers became less aggressive towards late morning, and offers pushed up to $215.
Traders said the market for high octane material was still very tight, with poor reforming margins cramping production.
Swaps were $1 firmer with the front-month spread 50 cents to $1 in backwardation.
